title: Case Provenance
description: Provenance block for a recorded behavior case (trigger case, logged event, audit assessment). Splits 'behavior observed on model M at date D' from 'behavior predicted to recur' from 'behavior already extinct'. Added by the 2026-09-09 update pass (check C1: model-version tagging; check C2: live vs historical). A case that cannot be tagged from its own record gets observed_on 'unknown' and status 'untested'; no model is inferred from context.

case_id.description: Stable identifier for the case (usually the source path or the log's own id).

source.description: Repository path, optionally with line range, where the case is recorded.

observed_on.description: Model family + version string as written in the record, or 'unknown'. Never inferred.

model_role.description: Whether the named model exhibited the behavior (subject), wrote the assessment (auditor), or took part without a recorded trigger behavior (participant).

observed_date.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime of the observation, or 'unknown'.

retest_condition.description: What result would show the behavior is extinct. Empty string is not allowed; write 'not re-testable: <why>' when no trigger behavior is recorded.

recurrence.description: Re-test attempts. Empty until a re-test is run.
